model.research_question: Under an unknown evaluation horizon, can a nonanticipating bandit policy attain the registered distribution-free target rate?
model.observation_model: Independent rewards supported on the unit interval with selected-arm feedback.
model.loss: Worst-case expected cumulative pseudo-regret through each evaluation horizon.

target.objective: Match the square-root order in arms and horizon without a logarithmic factor while preserving unknown-horizon operation.

verifier_suite.semantic_scope: Checks exact equality of declared candidate and target assumption fields.
verifier_suite.limitation: Does not establish that an algorithm or cited theorem truly satisfies those declarations.

verifier_suite.semantic_scope: Compares the candidate's separately declared horizon-information interface with the branch assumption.
verifier_suite.limitation: Checks a declared interface field only and does not inspect executable algorithm code or theorem assumptions.

verifier_suite.semantic_scope: Checks exact equality of registered polynomial and logarithmic rate signatures.
verifier_suite.limitation: Does not prove a regret bound, constants, uniformity, or applicability of a source theorem.

ai_may_propose: solution candidates under the registered specification
versioned model or verifier revisions with explicit costs
questions that expose a possible mismatch in problem identity
human_must_decide: whether any model or verifier revision creates a new branch
whether a control-compatible candidate deserves semantic review
whether scientific evidence supports a theorem-level conclusion
human_judgment_boundary.scientific_claim_rule: A deterministic control pass is not scientific evidence and cannot establish a theorem without an independent semantic verifier or explicit human review of the evidence.
